'''Magnetite''' is a brittle rock with magnetic properties found throughout [[Pharloom]]. It can also be displayed in the [[Materium]].

== Background ==
Magnetite is a blue coloured, magnetic stone that is usually found in clumps of varying sizes suspended in the air. It has a unique property that allows it to be tuned to attract specific materials.<ref name="brooch">[[Magnetite Brooch]] description: <i>"Holy stone inscribed with a prayer for rosaries. Any loose beads will be pulled toward the wearer."</i></ref> Magnetite platforms are created from a magnetite core attracting bits of bone and stone rubble to form a solid surface, and the [[Magnetite Brooch]] is able to pull [[Rosaries]] towards the bearer from long distances.<ref name="brooch" /><ref name="grindle">Description in [[Grindle]]'s shop for the [[Magnetite Brooch]]: <i>"Very, very lucky little trinket we got 'ere! Pulls 'em little clickie-clackies right into yer waitin' claws!"</i></ref>

Magnetite platforms are brittle and will crumble as soon as [[Hornet]] walks or climbs on them, but their Magnetite core allows them to reform quickly after. They are found primarily in the west end of Pharloom, particularly in [[the Marrow]], [[Wormways]], and [[Mount Fay]]. A few can also be found in [[Deep Docks]] and one on the eastern end of [[Weavenest Atla]], below the Marrow. Numerous can be found in the Skull Cave in [[Far Fields]], as well as during the [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] escape sequence in [[Act 3]] below Deep Docks. Several Magnetite platforms can also be seen in the background in Mount Fay and the space below Deep Docks. 

Magnetite may also have the ability to alter luck or influence accuracy, as seen with the [[Magnetite Dice]]. Both the Magnetite Brooch and the Magnetite Dice are also associated with luck or being lucky in text and dialogue. <ref name="grindle"/><ref>[[Magnetite Dice]] description: <i>"Used in simple games and believed to bring luck to the bearer."</i></ref>

[[The Citadel]] [[The Choir|choir]] bugs studied Magnetite in the [[Memorium]], the [[Memoria|Memoriae]] having several samples stored in transparent cases in the exhibit room in northeastern section. The blue material found inside the Materium in the Memorium, [[Bellhome]] and the Inventory icon appears to be Magnetite.

== Use ==
The entry can be seen in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the [[Materium]].

== How to Acquire ==
The Materium entry for Magnetite can be acquired in [[Brightvein]] in [[Act 3]], requiring the [[Silk Soar]] to access. This entry does not count toward 100% completion.

== Trivia ==
* Magnetite is the name of a [[wikipedia:Magnetite|real-world mineral]] that is ferrimagnetic, meaning it is attracted to magnets and can become magnetic itself. Naturally-magnetic magnetite, traditionally called lodestone, was the source of the original discovery of magnetism.
